long_biography.plain_text:
By 2001, Lefevre controlled Cercleurop International directly and through IFCP, its holding company. He later chaired the group's operating company until 2011, when IFCP assumed the presidency, and thereafter spoke publicly as group president. He now serves as an IFCP director and is responsible for its daily management.

Cercleurop distributes industrial packaging equipment and consumables across strapping, pallet wrapping, adhesives and protective materials. Under Lefevre, the group developed automated wrapping machinery, thinner stretch films and customized products designed to reduce handling strain and material use. Its manufacturing subsidiary Rubafilm supports film production, while the broader business also provides rental, maintenance, repair and reconditioning services.
